instruction: I am in the process of hiring for Software Engineer role for my company. I have selected candidates and prepared acceptance/rejection email templates and the offer letter template. You can find it all in "~/documents/work/recruiting" in my file system. The candidates have applied to this position by emailing me over the last 2 weeks. Please reply to them individually following the appropriate decision templates.
notes: Apps: file_system (constant `file-system`), gmail, supervisor. All actions are now named exactly <app>-<api_name>; gmail.reply_to_email is a single action whose attachment_file_paths parameter is an `attachment` object: for selected candidates it is the personalized offer letter file (made ready by file_system.create_file from the offer template, which requires the file_system token), for rejected candidates it is the `no-attachment` object (empty list) that is ready from the start. Token objects are tied to their app via the static (token-for-app) fact so each login yields its own token. The number of applicants is private data; the problem instantiates 4 placeholder candidates (candidate-a/b selected, candidate-c/d rejected) bound at runtime from the selected-candidates file and the inbox search; adjust the object set and the arity of supervisor-complete-task if the real count differs. Decisions, application email/thread mapping, and body/offer derivations are hidden world truths in :init, gated by knowledge predicates (directory-listed, file-read of the selection list and templates, applications-searched), so the plan must list the recruiting directory, read all four files, log into both apps and search inbox threads (query 'Software Engineer', min_created_at = 2 weeks before 2023-05-18) before replying. Replies go to each candidate's own application email (keeping 'Re: ' subject and response_to_email_id), one recipient each, with bodies from the acceptance/rejection templates. supervisor-complete-task takes the four candidate records (pairwise distinct) so its precondition equals the goal conjunction, and it is forced last by (not (task-completed)) on every other action. show_inbox_threads is assumed to expose email ids of the emails in each thread.
